name: Yule Lad
body:
YULE LAD
CR 6

This tall, raw-boned gnome has a sly smile on its misshapen face and long, gnarled arms and legs.

XP 2,400
CN Medium humanoid (giant)
Init +4; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 13, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +7 natural, ?1 size)
hp 75 (6d8+48); regeneration 5 (acid or fire)
Fort +13, Ref +6, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 10 ft.
Melee 2 claws +10 (1d6+7)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+10)

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 18, Con 27, Int 10, Wis 13, Cha 10
Base Atk +4; CMB +12 (+14 dirty trick or steal); CMD 26 (28 vs. dirty trick or steal)
Feats Improved Dirty Trick B, Improved Steal B, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Skill Focus (Perception)
Skills Intimidate +14, Perception +13, Sleight of Hand +10
Languages Giant

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Trickster (Su)

When a Yule Lad strikes a creature in melee or demoralizes it with an Intimidate check, it can perform a dirty trick or steal combat maneuver against the same target as a swift action. As a full-round action, it can make a single dirty trick combat maneuver check and apply the result against all creatures it can reach, affecting each target with the same effect.

ECOLOGY

Environment any cold or temperate
Organization solitary, pair, or gang (3-13)
Treasure standard

Grýla has thirteen sons, known as the Yule Lads. They resemble oversized and muscular gnomes with bushy beards, oversized ears and noses, and long, gnarled limbs.

Though their stature is small for their giantish blood, they are even stronger than ordinary trolls, if less cruel than their monstrous mother. The Yule Lads typically play somewhat dangerous pranks on people while Grýla goes hunting, which in some cases provides enough of distraction to allow her to hunt unimpeded. Each typically focuses on a particular kind of mischief, harassing farm animals, stealing food, peeping at doors and windows, slamming doors, and snatching trinkets. However, if she demands they help her more directly, they quickly fall in line. When one or more of her sons dies, Grýla’s husband can impregnate her, and she restores the number of Yule Lads to thirteen—carrying all the replacement children at once—after a year’s gestation.

These newborn Yule Lads reach full their full size and power after one month.
